# Library

The library sub-graph — a NAMED SUB-GRAPH of the harness on the pattern of `sdlc/` and `openapi/`, holding everything about libraries: the skills that teach acquisition, ingestion, cataloguing, translation and materialisation (`library-core`, `large-datasets`), the processes that run them, with their decision tables, and this layer's own corpus of cited sources. The graphs inside it — `library-skills`, `library-processes` and `library` — are declared FROM WITHIN, in `library/graph.json` (#980). The sub-graph itself is ON in every layer, because the content layers ingest with its skills and call its processes; only the corpus inside it is OPT-IN (owner, 2026-11-04, card 'Library cut' option 1: the skills and processes always on, the corpus opt-in). The id is not `library` on purpose: a layer above that declares its own `library` replaces an inherited entry of that id, and would take this sub-graph's skills and processes with it.

Part of [C@T Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `library-graph`, holding `cat-harness`.
